selection_rule: Four largest recorded expert_length values, index tie-break; no outcome selection. Stop after first complete episode with >=220 decisions. No extra episodes or retry.
warmup: Replay first 300 decisions; if the sequence is shorter, concatenate another replay prefix after the original official boundary semantics. All warmup inputs are captured real inputs.
sampling: Greedy primary; paired Torch categorical draws use restored common RNG state.
capture_boundary: Root Actor forward_encoder output plus masks, previous actions, episode timestep, object-in-hand; also capture actual decoder input/output and raw linear logits. No added live forward or simulator query.
